chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed-Husayn ibn Ulwan-Amr ibn Shimr-Jabir-Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said:

I asked him about the instant of the Angel of Death. He said: Do you not see people sitting, then cardiac failure/seizure overtakes them, so none of them speaks? That is the instant of the Angel of Death where he notices them.
ai.seo_question: What is the physical and spiritual sign of the Angel of Death's arrival at the moment of death?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) demystifies the metaphysical moment of death by linking it to the observable phenomenon of 'sakta' (sudden stillness or cardiac arrest), where the soul begins its departure while the body remains momentarily conscious but unable to speak. This explanation aligns with Shia scholarly tradition that views death not as an instantaneous event but as a transitional process initiated by the Angel of Death's gaze, offering comfort by framing the final breath as a natural, albeit sudden, physiological and spiritual transition.
